svg.title: Sky coverage: TESS, Kepler, K2 and the unmapped sky
svg.desc: Sky coverage on an equal-area Mollweide map in equatorial coordinates (right ascension increasing to the left, declination ±90°), as of 2026-10-18. TESS sectors 1 to 110 cover 97.8% of the sky, shaded by the number of sectors (1–2, 3–5, 6–12, 13 or more; 13 or more is 4.9%). Kepler's field covers 0.3% and the K2 campaigns C0–C19 4.5%, drawn from their CCD channel outlines; the sky in no footprint (TESS, Kepler, K2, CoRoT or the bulge) is 2.1%. Of 5,433 planet hosts, 5,381 lie in TESS's sky, 1,362 in Kepler's field, 661 in K2's and 35 in none. The dashed line is the Galactic plane. Source: docs/results/survey_coverage.json (tess-point and K2fov footprints), commit 54b255e.
